SessionStart.command: if [ -f docs/plan/backlog.yaml ]; then echo '=== BACKLOG STATE ==='; head -80 docs/plan/backlog.yaml; echo; echo '=== SESSION LOG (last 10) ==='; tail -10 docs/plan/session-log.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No previous session'; fi

SubagentStop.command: if [ -f docs/plan/backlog.yaml ]; then printf '%s | Subagent completed\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> docs/plan/session-log.md; fi
